Murray State men's basketball to play exhibition at Wichita State Wednesday night
Murray State men's basketball opens its exhibition slate against Wichita State on Wednesday night at Wichita. Fans can follow via radio or live stats as both teams prepare for highly anticipated seasons following strong finishes last year.
The Murray State men's basketball team will begin its exhibition schedule on Wednesday night, traveling to face Wichita State in a 6:30 p.m. matchup, according to an Oct. 6 announcement. The game will not be streamed online, but fans can follow the action through live stats or by listening to Froggy 103.7 FM, with Dave Winder and Kenny Roth providing commentary.
Fans in the Murray area can listen live on Froggy 103.7 FM or stream the station nationwide via the Varsity App by searching for Murray State.
Murray State enters the season after finishing with a 20-13 overall record last year and a 12-8 mark in Missouri Valley Conference play, securing third place in the league standings—the program's best regular season finish and most conference wins since joining The Valley.
The Racers' roster includes nine newcomers this season—four transfers and five freshmen—alongside six returning players from last year's squad. Of those returners, only three saw playing time last year: Courbon, Domon, and Shorter. The team also features seven foreign-born players: four from France (Boulefaa, Courbon, Domon, Soulhac), one from Slovenia (Padjen), one from Serbia (Nikolic), and one from New Zealand (Crate).
Wichita State finished last season with a 24-12 record and went 13-5 in American Conference play before reaching the championship game of their conference tournament and advancing to the quarterfinal round of the National Invitation Tournament. Ten Shockers return for this season, including American Conference Sixth Man of the Year Will Berg as well as Dillon Battie, TJ Williams, and Michael Gray Jr.
Both teams are ranked among Ryan Hammer's Mid-Major Power 30 entering this preseason matchup: Murray State is ranked No. 6 while Wichita State holds No. 3. Other Missouri Valley Conference members Illinois State (No. 12) and UIC (No. 13) are also listed alongside Tennessee State (No. 17), who Murray State will face during the Field of 68 Opening Day Marathon that marks their official start to the season.
Over the summer, Murray State played games in Spain, Greece, and France as part of an international trip where they went undefeated at 4-0 while averaging over one hundred points per game.
